package onboarding

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type pathOutcomeHandoffLookup struct {
	intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent
}

func (lookup pathOutcomeHandoffLookup) GetByPlannerHandoffID(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	return lookup.intent, true, nil
}

type pathOutcomeStore struct {
	record     *domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord
	markErrors []error
}

func (store *pathOutcomeStore) Accept(_ context.Context, input domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord, bool, error) {
	if store.record == nil {
		copy := input
		store.record = &copy
		return copy, true, nil
	}
	return *store.record, false, nil
}

func (store *pathOutcomeStore) MarkDelivered(_ context.Context, _, messageID string, at time.Time) error {
	if len(store.markErrors) > 0 {
		err := store.markErrors[0]
		store.markErrors = store.markErrors[1:]
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if store.record == nil {
		return errors.New("outcome not accepted")
	}
	store.record.DialogMessageID = messageID
	store.record.DeliveredAt = &at
	return nil
}

type pathOutcomeReadiness struct {
	result domain.TeacherLearningReadiness
	err    error
}

func (readiness pathOutcomeReadiness) ResolveLearningReadiness(context.Context, string, domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (domain.TeacherLearningReadiness, error) {
	return readiness.result, readiness.err
}

type pathOutcomeDialog struct {
	calls     int
	mutations int
}

func (dialog *pathOutcomeDialog) AppendTeacherProactive(_ context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, _, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	dialog.calls++
	if dialog.calls == 1 {
		dialog.mutations++
	}
	return domain.DialogMessage{ID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", DialogID: binding.ID,
		AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, PersonalTeacherID: binding.PersonalTeacherID,
		Body: body, Status: 1, Version: 1}, nil
}

type pathOutcomeClock struct{}

func (pathOutcomeClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }

func TestPathOutcomeHandlerCorrelatesAndDeliversExactlyOnceAcrossReplay(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	teacherID := "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	dialogID := "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	handoffID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	teacherJobID := "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	intent := domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, DialogID: dialogID,
		PlannerHandoffID: handoffID, CommandTeacherJobID: teacherJobID, Locale: "en"}
	outcome := domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", EventType: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject,
		CorrelationID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CausationID: handoffID, StudentID: studentID,
		OccurredAt: pathOutcomeClock{}.Now(), ExecutionID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", HandoffID: handoffID,
		DialogID: dialogID, TeacherJobID: teacherJobID, Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathReady,
		CourseID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", LearningPathID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", FirstLessonID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"}
	store := &pathOutcomeStore{markErrors: []error{errors.New("crash after Dialog append"), nil}}
	dialog := &pathOutcomeDialog{}
	handler := PathOutcomeHandler{Handoffs: pathOutcomeHandoffLookup{intent: intent}, Outcomes: store, Readiness: pathOutcomeReadiness{}, Dialogs: dialog, Clock: pathOutcomeClock{}}

	processed, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), outcome)
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.False(t, processed)
	processed, err = handler.Handle(context.Background(), outcome)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.False(t, processed)
	require.Equal(t, 2, dialog.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.mutations)
	require.NotNil(t, store.record.DeliveredAt)
}

func TestPathOutcomeHandlerRejectsMismatchedHandoffIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	handoffID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	outcome := domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", EventType: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject,
		CorrelationID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CausationID: handoffID, StudentID: studentID,
		OccurredAt: pathOutcomeClock{}.Now(), ExecutionID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", HandoffID: handoffID,
		DialogID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", TeacherJobID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathActiveExists}
	handler := PathOutcomeHandler{Handoffs: pathOutcomeHandoffLookup{intent: domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{StudentID: studentID, DialogID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", PlannerHandoffID: handoffID}}, Outcomes: &pathOutcomeStore{}, Readiness: pathOutcomeReadiness{}, Dialogs: &pathOutcomeDialog{}, Clock: pathOutcomeClock{}}
	_, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), outcome)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome)
}
